name: AcDefView
description: Use with the DefaultView property to set or return the opening view of a form.

constants.name: acDefViewSingle
constants.description: (Default) Displays one record at a time.

constants.name: acDefViewContinuous
constants.description: The form displays multiple records (as many as will fit in the current window), each in its own copy of the form's detail section.

constants.name: acDefViewDatasheet
constants.description: Displays the form fields arranged in rows and columns like a spreadsheet.

constants.name: acDefViewPivotTable
constants.description: Displays the form as a PivotTable.

constants.name: acDefViewPivotChart
constants.description: Displays the form as a PivotChart.

constants.name: acDefViewSplitForm
constants.description: Displays the form in Split Form view.
